PERIDOT MARKETS

One group. Three ways to compose.

An isolated lending market connects to a yield venue, a price source and a funded reward token through shared interfaces.

Yield

Keep a liquid buffer (10% to 100%). Route eligible idle deposits through the vault interface into allowlisted DeFindex vaults or Blend fee vaults.

Prices

Reflector feeds with an explicit token, oracle and asset mapping approved by the factory. Guardrails bound the risk a group owner can select.

Rewards

Fund a group reward token and choose emissions per market. Rewards are enabled last because they lock the market list.

Prior work, clearly separated

Core lending contracts are Peridot's audited contracts with one change for the hackathon: upgrade and admin-parameter timelocks shortened from 24h to 60s. New contracts are unaudited.

Before HackMeridian	This build
Peridot lending, margin V3 and yield contracts	Factories and configurable isolated groups
Peridot dashboard and V2 frontend references	Launch wizard and group-specific screens
Lending and margin liquidator code	New group configuration and operations

This table describes scope. Completed milestones require deployment and transaction evidence.

Built to grow in phases

Phase 1 connects lending, rewards and optional margin with DeFindex and Blend routes. Later phases add Aquarius with a capped loss reserve, more price modes, Zenex, XOXNO and a hosted keeper service. Loss cover is limited to the reserve balance.
